plan.name: v1.9.6-bridge-attest-events
plan.info: Emit bridge attestation events for all submissions

title: Upgrade: v1.9.6-bridge-attest-events
summary:
This upgrade ensures all bridge attestation submissions emit events, not just those that contribute to threshold.

Problem:
- When a validator submits an attestation after threshold is already met, no event was emitted
- The indexer recorded the attestation but couldn't get the power from the (missing) event
- Result: UI showed '4 validators but 75%' because the late validator had power=0

Changes:
- Late attestations (after threshold met) now emit bridge_attest with late=true attribute
- Duplicate attestations (validator re-submits) now emit bridge_attest with duplicate=true attribute
- Same fix applied to both inbound (bridgeAttestBurned) and outbound (bridgeAttestMinted) flows
- Indexers can now track all validator participation accurately

BINARY REQUIREMENT: All validators must update to v1.9.6 binary BEFORE the upgrade height.
